items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, me and Fats was tight.

ctx.x: What about Clark? You just mentioned Fats.

Yeah, me and Fats was tight. We used to hang out a lot together. In fact he even lived – when I moved to – I moved to Stanton Terrace with my mother when we got out of Corcoran Street. We moved to 1892 Stanton Terrace, which is out by Alabama Road.
